items.en_oneliner: With October peak-season signals weak, air freight rates and capacity pressure remain, so leave extra time for restocking.

items.title: eBay adds visual identification to listing generation options
items.zh_title: eBay 上架工具新增视觉识别功能
items.zh_oneliner: 拍张照片就能生成刊登信息，卖家上架的速度会更快。
items.en_oneliner: Sellers can now generate listings from a single photo, speeding up the listing process.

items.title: Dick’s Sporting Goods signs Caitlin Clark
items.zh_title: Dick’s 体育用品签下 Caitlin Clark
items.zh_oneliner: 体育零售商押注明星运动员带货，门店与线上一起造势。
items.en_oneliner: The sporting goods retailer is betting on star athletes to drive sales, in stores and online.

items.title: BMW announces new battery supply deals for the US, Europe
items.zh_title: 宝马签下美欧电池供应大单
items.zh_oneliner: 宝马与三星 SDI 和 LG 合作推进电池本土化，供应链区域化趋势仍在继续。
items.en_oneliner: BMW is partnering with Samsung SDI and LG to localize battery production, as supply-chain regionalization continues.

items.title: WooCommerce 11.3.0: Release notes
items.zh_title: WooCommerce 11.3.0 发布说明
items.zh_oneliner: 新版让店主更好控制商品与促销展示，新增促销徽章选项和图库滑动体验。
items.en_oneliner: The release gives store owners more control over product and promotion displays, adding promo badges and a gallery swipe experience.

items.title: Michael Kors, Jimmy Choo owner names new CEO
items.zh_title: Michael Kors 与 Jimmy Choo 母公司任命新 CEO
items.zh_oneliner: 奢侈品集团换帅，品牌与渠道策略可能随之调整。
items.en_oneliner: The luxury group has named a new CEO, and brand and channel strategy may shift as a result.

items.title: Fiserv preps debit network sale
items.zh_title: Fiserv 准备出售借记卡网络
items.zh_oneliner: 支付巨头正把客户迁移到其中一个借记网络，为出售或关闭另一个做准备。
items.en_oneliner: The payments giant is migrating customers onto one debit network as it prepares to sell or shut down the other.

items.title: Amazon’s Black Friday, Cyber Monday deals boast record exclusives
items.zh_title: 亚马逊黑五与网一独家优惠创纪录
items.zh_oneliner: 大促的独家商品越来越多，卖家要提前抢好活动坑位。
items.en_oneliner: Exclusive deals keep multiplying for the holiday sales, so sellers should secure event slots early.
